title: Google Sign-In Support for Non-GMS & Huawei Devices
releaseNotes: Added automatic browser-based Google Sign-In fallback on Android devices without Google Play Services (such as newer Huawei devices).
Kept existing native Google Sign-In as the primary flow on Play Services devices while syncing all accounts to the same profile without duplicates.
Improved Google Sign-In cancellation and error messages so failures are clearly reported instead of failing silently.
